name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Aurora CO

fieldNotes.truckGate: Single access driveway off N Jackson Gap Way. z20 curb-cut imagery shows an open, wide entry with landscaped islands and turn-lane markings, but NO barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at the public road. Classified as open entry (false).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth straddling the truck lane at the entrance. Structures near the operations yard (39.8066/-104.6936 area and the bottom-center white building) are ancillary/maintenance/utility buildings, not an entrance guard booth. Marked uncertain because a modern Ocado CFC likely has access-controlled internal gates not resolvable from overhead.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate present, so remoteGs is false by rule.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved holding area on the west side where Kroger Delivery vans and inbound trailers stage before docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West building face carries the loading docks (trailers + refrigerated vans backed in). Counted ~10-12 dock positions in one z19 frame; extrapolated across the ~700ft west face to the 25-50 band. Low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated west-side van/trailer staging lot with ~30-40 marked angled stalls holding Kroger Delivery refrigerated vans and drop trailers; plus a trailer strip along the north edge.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry apron and abundant unused paved width on the approach drive; ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Far-NE edge of Aurora on open prairie/former farmland near the DEN airport corridor; broader setting is edge-of-town open country, so Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main 300,000 sq ft CFC plus one ancillary maintenance/utility building in the SW operations yard.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer/van storage lot on the west side, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.streetViewMeta: Nearest Street View panos on N Jackson Gap Way are dated 2016-11 (gate area, ~170m E) and 2020-11 (perimeter, ~140m E) — both PREDATE the 2023 CFC construction and show empty prairie, not the facility. hasCoverage set false because no pano depicts the built yard; never invented a pano. Gate/perimeter determinations rely on Maxar satellite (z18-z21).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is unrelated.

citations.claim: Colorado CFC is among the CFCs Kroger and Ocado plan to keep operating.
Kroger 300k sqft CFC at 6125 N. Jackson Gap Way, Aurora CO serving Denver metro.

verification.rationale: Aurora/Denver CO CFC named among RETAINED sites in Dec 2025 pullback; active openings.
